content:
evan_marketing: Quick thread 1: need a compact battlecard + webinar blurb focused on competitive positioning vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Theme: 'Serve-first economics' — emphasize p95 predictability, transparent unit cost, and fallback policies. Deliverables: SDR one-pager, 1-slide bench blurb, procurement objection handlers. EOD Tue. Who can pick this up?

claire_research: I can supply sanitized bench highlights. Note: internal only until legal reviews. Short paste below.

```text
Workload: multi-turn assistant, avg seq 340 tokens
Testbed: eu-west-1, A100-class nodes, steady 70% util, 600 concurrent sessions
Redwood (prod-profile): p50 37ms, p95 100ms, cost-per-convo $0.016
CloudAPI (managed): p50 84ms, p95 220ms, cost-per-convo $0.042
Self-host baseline: p50 31ms, p95 300ms (spiky), cost-per-convo $0.028
```

omar_sales: I'll own the SDR one-pager + procurement scripts. Need 3 tight hooks and 3 rebuttals for "we already have infra", "data sensitivity", "pricing".

jas_content: I'll draft the hero for the webinar landing and the 1-line bench blurb for the slide. Candidate hero: "Predictable inference: lower tail latency, clearer unit economics, automatic fallbacks." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

evan_marketing: Love the hero. Jas, please make a 12-word variant for social. Claire: add 1-liner test conditions for slide (region, node class, concurrency). Use relative phrasing publicly: "~2x lower p95 vs CloudAPI in our tests".

claire_research: Test conditions line: "eu-west-1; A100-class nodes; steady-state 70% GPU util; 600 concurrent sessions simulated." Adding methodology caveat: "Quantized model profile; synthetic traffic mix; results vary by model/workload."

bench_bot: artifacts-upload: bench bundle at internal storage (link removed)

omar_sales: Draft SDR hooks: 1) "Worried about tail latency at peak? We keep p95 predictable and provide tiered fallbacks." 2) "Want clearer unit economics? We expose per-conv costing and batching recommendations." 3) "Prefer not to run opaque endpoints? We offer Dedicated and Private with enterprise controls." Rebuttals (short): "we have infra" -> "Reduce ops burden with our unified control plane and rollouts; Dedicated integrates with your infra." "data sensitivity" -> "Private/VPC deployments + KMS/HSM + audit logs." "pricing" -> "Show me 1M convs/mo and we'll model reserved vs on-demand savings."

jas_content: One-line slide blurb: "In our tests (eu-west-1, A100-class), Redwood delivered ~2x lower p95 vs CloudAPI and materially lower cost-per-conversation in the tested workload. Internal only."

evan_marketing: Good. Action items: Omar -> finalize SDR one-pager + procurement script by 4pm; Jas -> hero variants + short social copy by 2pm; Claire -> sanitized slide table + caveat by EOD. I'll assemble the battlecard and schedule a 10m dry-run Wed 9:50am PT. Keep claims conservative and label internal where needed.

omar_sales: On it. Will post the ROI example (1M convs/mo) here when ready.

jas_content: Will A/B test two hero variants in the landing: full and short. Posting drafts soon.

claire_research: Will also provide a tiny chart (sanitized) for the slide deck.

evan_marketing: Thanks team — tagging owners in thread. Dry-run Wed 9:50am PT.

(END)
